# statuspage_page (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_page" "example" {
  id = "abc123def456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `id` (String) Page identifier.
